neighbours.label: ' chief' used as an adjective meaning 'main/principal' ('his chief rival', 'her chief concern'), not as a job title
fire: Wellington's chief opponent in the campaign was Marshal Soult.
My chief worry about the trip is the weather.
The senator's chief ally in the debate stayed silent.
Their chief complaint was the noise from the street.
Sparta's chief rival for power was Athens.
His chief aim was to finish the book by spring.
The novel's chief flaw is its slow middle section.
Our chief goal this year is to cut costs.
quiet: Wellington's main opponent in the campaign was Marshal Soult.

Their main complaint was the noise from the street.
Sparta's great rival for power was Athens.
